title: Casa Calpes
thumbnail_desc: A home with soul in the heart of the most authentic Poblenou
description: A one-of-a-kind property. In a city defined by housing scarcity and a growing demand for homes with history and character, Casa Clapés stands out as a truly unique presence on Barcelona’s map. Located in the historic Barri de la Plata, in the heart of Poblenou, this singular corner house—with a protected façade, private terraces, and a documented century-old history—has no equivalent on the current market. The proposal envisions the creation of a patio enclosed by a glass wall, opening the home’s communal areas—the day zone—to natural light. An elegant metallic structure forms a subtle bridge connecting the terrace with the living room, while the double-height space grants the entrance the scale needed to fully perceive the beauty and elegance of the house.
location: Passatge de Mas de Roda, 5, Barcelona
